title: First International Hotel Opens in Swat Valley
excerpt: Grace Hospitality brings the Best Western Premier brand to Kalam in the Swat Valley, marking its first international hotel.
body_html:
The Swat Valley has received its first international hotel brand with the introduction of the Best Western Premier Kalam. The property was announced by Grace Hospitality, bringing globally recognized hospitality standards to the scenic region.

Located in Kalam, the new hotel aims to offer visitors upgraded lodging options in one of Pakistan's prominent tourist destinations. Grace Hospitality stated that the development marks a notable addition to the local hospitality sector, introducing an established international name to the area's tourism landscape.
